instruction: Candid outdoor photograph, full shot. In a sunny park with green grass, a group plays a lawn game. On the left, the bald man in a dark blue t-shirt (R2) stands facing right, laughing. Next to him, the large Black man in a black t-shirt (R1) celebrates, holding hands mid-air with the woman in a dark blue t-shirt and light blue jeans (R4), who faces left. On the right, the Black woman with a large afro in a red t-shirt (R6) stands watching. In the far right background, a heavily blurred bystander is visible. Bright sunlight filters through the trees.
